# TradingView Lightweight Charts

Official npm package `lightweight-charts`, pinned to **5.2.1**.
The standalone production bundle is copied unchanged from
`dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js` and served locally, with no
runtime CDN or npm dependency. Apache 2.0 license and upstream NOTICE are included.
The chart displays TradingView's attribution logo and a visible attribution link.

Source: https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts/tree/v5.2.1
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/lightweight-charts/-/lightweight-charts-5.2.1.tgz
Package SHA1: `5a27ead719573607d4d3483ad2728c055ccea8fd`
